item.title: Flights halted at airports across US due to unspecified ‘extraordinary circumstances,’ FAA says
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration has grounded all flights nationwide. The FAA notice on Friday afternoon said the ground stop was being imposed “due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety.”

item.title: Family Dollar to pay $63 million to settle allegations that it routinely overcharged customers
item.description: Family Dollar will pay $63 million to settle state and federal allegations that it routinely charged customers more at the register than the prices displayed on its shelves or on its website and mobile app.

item.title: Son of former CIA Director John Brennan arrested on child sexual abuse images charge
item.description: The son of former CIA Director John Brennan is facing a federal charge related to child sexual abuse images, according to court papers unsealed Friday.

item.title: Joe Biden's White House memoir is an unapologetic defense of four years sandwiched between Trump
item.description: In his White House memoir, former President Joe Biden offers an unapologetic defense of his four year tenure that started with his defeat of Donald Trump and ended with Trump's return to power.

item.title: Van Hollen rules out White House run as he mounts bid to replace Schumer as Senate leader
item.description: Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he’s no longer considering a presidential run as he is making his pitch to become Senate majority leader.
